recipes.name: Fast · copy 4 + fast 3
recipes.note: QI2.1 NVFP4 + Viggle turbo r128, bench qi21_v2: 6.6s, LPIPS 0.073 (worst 0.131), sharpness 0.94

recipes.name: Text · balanced + refine (.25, cfg 3)
recipes.note: For images with lettering: balanced, then renoise to σ 0.25 and finish with 3 base steps at cfg 3 (freezes text). 11.6s vs ~19.7s for 25 steps

recipes.name: Text+ · balanced + heavy refine (.5, cfg 3)
recipes.note: For tiny hand-written / cursive lettering: balanced, then renoise to σ 0.5 and redraw with 6 base steps at cfg 3. ~14.8s vs ~18.9s for 25 steps; recovers small cursive the Text recipe cannot

recipes.name: Reference 25 steps (cfg 1 ×20, cfg 3 ×5)
recipes.note: Reference: cfg 3 only on the last 5 steps keeps text sharp without burning glass/transparent materials

recipes.name: Z-Image · base 2 + turbo 10
recipes.note: Z-Image base (+Distill 8-step LoRA 0.8) → Z-Image Turbo on fast_model: 12 steps res_multistep, base draws 2. Pixel-identical to two chained KSamplerAdvanced; 8.7s on RTX 5060 Ti (NVFP4)

recipes.name: Z-Image · sketch 1 + turbo 6
recipes.note: Sketch DiT (Z-Image base + Distill 4-step LoRA 0.8 merged, Q2 GGUF 2.98G) on model draws 1 step (σ 1→0.9, cfg 1) and fixes the composition; Z-Image Turbo on fast_model finishes 6 steps. 6.6s on RTX 5060 Ti.

recipes.name: Z-Image · sketch 1 + turbo 8
recipes.note: Sketch DiT on model draws 1 step (σ 1→0.9, cfg 1) to fix the composition; Z-Image Turbo on fast_model walks 8 steps from σ 0.9 along the shift-3 curve. Best of a sweep over 4–10 Turbo steps and handoff σ 0.833/0.9/0.955. 7.5 s on RTX 5060 Ti.
